required_before_production.description: Staging simulator runbook evidence covering successful verification, same-wallet retry, different-wallet conflict, snapshot save/load, and QR/export review.
Full-stack Playwright evidence with live wallet API and mocked Developer Portal verification.
Desktop and mobile accessibility, fallback, no-overflow, no-overclaim, and no-leak screenshots and test output.
Privacy review that confirms nullifiers are stored as commitments, raw IDKit payloads remain backend-private, and QR/export metadata is sanitized.
Security signoff covering RP signing keys, secret references, production readiness checks, and login/recovery non-key guardrails.
Support/on-call evidence for disabled World ID, unavailable simulator, nullifier conflict, revoke/unlink wording, and manual fallback paths.
Target readiness report with world_id_environment, world_id_secret_references, world_id_rp_signature_vector, world_id_verify_endpoint, and world_id_proof_sanitization checks set to ok.
Human product-owner approval in the completed target signoff packet before production enablement.

production_enablement_rule: Do not enable WORLD_ID_ENVIRONMENT=production until the target signoff packet validates and all World ID evidence IDs resolve in the approved evidence system.
